data.title: 矢来美羽 · 屋顶上的联络
data.description: 屋顶风大，她按住帽檐，听完对讲机里的消息后才看向海面。
data.action: holding a radio and steadying her cap
data.promptProse: Standing on a rooftop terrace overlooking the sea at twilight, Miu holds a security radio to her ear while steadying the brim of her peaked cap. Distant evening clouds and antenna towers frame her calm, attentive posture against the coastal horizon.
data.animaCaption: Soft rooftop light reveals her face, radio and the sea horizon.
